title: 不眠都市の論理的欠落
author: 九条 レイ

en.title: The Logical Void of the Sleepless City
en.premise: In a locked room boasting impenetrable security, a businessman is found dead. What remains at the scene is an unnatural void: the disappearance of a 'will' that should have been there. A cold, calculating logician detective declares that the very 'absence' of the missing letter is the ultimate piece of evidence, as he begins to unravel the logical trap set by the culprit.

zh.title: 不眠都市的逻辑缺失
zh.premise: 在拥有完美安保系统的密室中，一名企业家被发现身亡。现场留下的是一个不自然的空白——本该存在的“遗嘱信件”竟然消失了。冷酷的逻辑学家侦探断言，这封失踪信件的“不在”正是最重要的证据，并开始逐步揭开犯人设下的逻辑陷阱。
